note: Shape-anisotropy MTJs already shown; Fe16N2 hard-magnet thin films remain hard to make reliably.
A passive spreader cannot hold junction below ambient; 125 C ambient to 105 C junction claim is unphysical.
Hf4+/Zr4+ are near-identical chemically; protein selectivity is a long shot but cheap to test via directed evolution.
Known solvent-extraction chemistry; mainly a funding/offtake policy, plant far exceeds $1M.
CXL compression expanders already pursued by vendors; FPGA demo straightforward.
Buckled-beam NEMS memories exist in research; 1e15+ endurance and density at DRAM pitch are the doubts.
Self-aligned hydrogen conversion of one film to conductor and channel is clever; H diffusion destroys contrast over thermal budget.
Cryo-DRAM (77 K) well studied; cooling overhead limits net gain to dense pooled racks.
DNA-templated lithography is known; placement defectivity and registration at 10-15 nm are unproven at wafer scale.
ZTO TFTs are mature in displays; off-current parity with IGZO is the question.
H2 conductivity matches He; flammability safety and chamber requalification are the main costs.
Cold-crucible Si melting exists for solar casting; 300 mm dislocation-free pulling from a skull melt is unproven.
2D-channel gain cells actively researched; low-temp MOCVD uniformity on glass is the doubt.
CCZ proven in solar and explored for semis; prime 300 mm oxygen uniformity qualification needs a puller.
Molybdenum replacement for W is widely pursued by toolmakers and memory makers.
Orbital torque in Cr/Ti is active research; SOT memory itself is a niche vs DRAM.
L10 MnAl films need high anneal; VCMA coefficients too weak for reliable writes today.
Negative back-gate standby to suppress off-current is plausible; 1e-23 A and >1 year at 85 C is aggressive.
Mist-CVD known for Ga2O3; electronic-grade amorphous films without vacuum need validation.
Minienvironments and FOUPs already standard; further ballroom downgrade is incremental.
DUV-only DRAM fabs lag on cost per bit; replication speed is a strategy claim, unprovable for $1M.
Biasing inside hysteresis requires constant standby power and tight window control; density and variability doubtful.
Field emission at DRAM voltages needs extreme tip enhancement; tip uniformity across billions of cells doubtful.
Si3N4 particles and nitrogen saturation risk dislocations in CZ; reuse claim untested at 300 mm.
4-6 nm vacuum gaps over tall fins face electrostatic pull-in and stiction; needs ~10x area.
Clever yield-binning combo, but TFT tiers at panel rules give low density; gigabytes per package doubtful.
NiO/hematite exchange bias used in early spin valves; thermal stability in scaled MTJs is the question.
ELTRAN-style transfer known; materials saved are a small share of wafer cost, so step change is modest.
Solar kerfless epi exists; DRAM-grade defect density in thick epi wafers is unproven.
Electrodeposited Si from fluoride melts is mostly polycrystalline; device-grade single-crystal wafers are a big leap.
LNG waste cold as heat sink is a siting twist on cryo-DRAM; requires co-located data halls.
Thin-tunnel SONOS DRAM tried in 2000s; 100 s at 125 C with 2 nm oxide conflicts with direct-tunnel leakage.
HSG roughening needs room inside the hole; sub-30 nm capacitors leave no space for grains.
ThruChip-style inductive coupling known; power delivery without TSVs limits HBM-class stacks.
Wurtzite ferroelectrics need ~3 MV/cm coercive fields near breakdown; coherent interface endurance is speculative.
Seeded laser recrystallization for monolithic 3D known; lower-tier thermal damage and defects are the doubts.
Hardwired weights proven concept; useful only for frozen models, re-spin cost per model update.
Self-selecting memory known (Micron); new sulfide composition's threshold window and endurance unknown.
Floating-body retention and margin issues killed Z-RAM beyond SOI cost; back gate helps but not proven.
sCO2 cleaning researched since 2000s; particle removal and throughput limited adoption.
S-layer templating known; protein lattice domains and thermal limits make dense reliable cells unlikely.
Cryogenic niche; MgB2 thin-film loops and cryotron switching density far from DRAM scale.
CXL pooling with statistical provisioning already studied (e.g., Pond); optics adds novelty modestly.
Without backside gas, wafer temperature control fails broadly, not just radially; ECC may not absorb it.
Single nanowire per 20 nm seed and hydrogen donor background doping make off-state control doubtful.
Glass substrates widely pursued (Intel and others); link energy gains mostly vs DDR, not HBM.
Catalyst-assisted etch avoids PFC plasma; catalyst wandering at ~20 nm holes and 100:1 is the key doubt.
Charge recycling in DRAM circuits has prior art; 40-50% recovery is optimistic given reservoir losses.
Si/SiO2 RTDs show weak room-temperature peak-to-valley ratios; cell area 2-3x DRAM.
Litho-free AAO hole lattice over tier stacks is novel; still needs deep etch and registration to bitlines.
AAO pores lack registration to cell transistors; imprinted seeds reduce but do not solve alignment.
1.5 um panel rules give very low density; LTPS leakage is high; capex per bit gain doubtful.
Display-line tiers could cut slow-tier $/GB ~10x; doubts: 20-tier yield, panel nanoimprint overlay, 100-300 ns latency.
FFC route known; Ca/Cl/metal contamination makes electronic-grade feedstock a long reach.
Sliding ferroelectricity demonstrated in lab flakes; wafer-scale controlled bilayer stacking and readout unresolved.
